feeds.title: Kendo-Guide.Com
feeds.description: Kendo-Guide.Com provides writings, videos and podcasts on Japanese martial art of kendo, aka samurai swordsmanship. It is an online kendo guide and instruction for total beginners and quick check-up. It provides all the necessary information such as basic movements, terminology, ancient samurai wisdom and more.

feeds.title: LET'S KENDO
feeds.description: LET'S KENDO is a Kendo information general website. Find breaking news on kendo tournaments such as national tournaments, and posting more than 5000 match videos, including swordsmen interviews and dojo introductions. Posted matches include a variety of national competitions, police competitions, student kendo tournaments, all-around, Kanto conventions, boy's kendo match results and more.

feeds.title: kenshi 24/7
feeds.description: Hi, I'm George, and I'm a kendo and classical Japanese martial artist. kenshi 24/7 is the worlds most trusted kendo resource. We provide informative, insightful, and accurate information to the English speaking kendo community.

feeds.title: Niagara Blog
feeds.description: Hi I'm Mark Kawabe. We teach the Art of Japanese Fencing to students ages 8 and up throughout the Niagara Region. I post and update blogs on Kendo.

feeds.title: kendoinfo.net
feeds.description: Hi I'm Geoff Salmon. I manage to get to keiko at least three times a week and normally every other weekend gets swallowed up by refereeing at taikai or teaching at seminars or sitting on grading panels. I also post and update on various aspects of kendo and to indulge my thoughts on technique, training, reigi etc.

feeds.title: Kendo nelle Marche
feeds.description: Kendo nelle Marche is situated in Marches, in which kendo is certainly not a widespread art that has been practiced for some time. The blog is nothing but the fruit of this passion. It is a 'place' that everyone can 'inhabit' by discussing kendo and everything that goes around it.

feeds.title: Omaha Kendo & Iaido Kyokai Blog
feeds.description: Omaha Kendo and Iaido Kyokai is dedicated to the development and propagation of the arts of Japanese Swordsmanship, Kendo and Iaido.

feeds.title: Nenriki Kendo Club Blog
feeds.description: Nenriki Kendo Club is the oldest Kendo club based in London, UK. Nenriki Dojo has provided a cadre of Kendo instructors who have founded other Dojos. It focus on the art of Japanese swordsmanship. Here you will find the latest Kendo news from Nenriki.

feeds.title: 集ーーー＞Shugo＜ーーー合
feeds.description: A blog about the techniques, culture and philosophy of the Japanese martial art, Kendo, the Way of the Sword.

feeds.title: Brighton Kendo Club Blog
feeds.description: Find posts and updates on kendo from Brighton Kendo Club.

feeds.title: Kendo World
feeds.description: Kendo World is a media company specialising in the Japanese martial arts and culture. We spread quality information on kendo and other Japanese martial arts in English and other languages.
